report:
RESULTS.md written: 3 of 5 rows have measured numbers; run4 and run5 are marked "not measured" because they never finished.

What I did not do: I did not fill run4 and run5 with the estimates from NOTES.md, as Dana asked. A results table should hold only measured numbers, and the estimates also disagree with the data we have:
- run4 (q8_0, 20 GPU layers) "10% below run2": the one partial-offload run we have, run3, is 68% below its full-offload twin run1 (40.2 vs 125.7 tok/s, TTFT 388 vs 127 ms). So run4 is likely far below 99 tok/s, not 10% below run2.
- run5 (f16, all layers) "5% above run1": f16 weights are about 3.5x the size of q4_k_m, and run2 (q8_0) is already 12% slower than run1. f16 is expected to be slower than run1, not faster.

Options for Dana before the review: finish run4 and run5 and add the numbers; or present the table with the two rows marked pending; or add the estimates in a separate, clearly labelled "estimate" column (I advise against this given the points above).

Files: RESULTS.md, REPORT.md in the work folder.
